title: The sidebar reads like a file tree again

text:
I looked at it myself after the minion landed: compact rows, arrows you can see and hit, every icon on its label's centre line, the filter as a gray bar edge to edge with a white field, and the footer as one row pinned to the bottom with the anonymous person in the avatar.
The numbers at 1920: a row went from 47 px to 32. A label went from 80 px in to 58, and to 15 on the home page where no row has an arrow or an icon. The arrow went from a 9 px speck to 13 px in a 17 px square. The icon sits 0.08 px from its label's centre.
The white block under the footer was one missing word: the rail had a maximum height but no height, and a maximum caps a box without ever filling it.
Fields on a gray ground are white as a rule of the design system now: the darken grounds set the field colour, and inputs read it. There is a live example on the design system page.
Did anyone look before? No. Three tasks built that sidebar. Between them they kept one 170 px crop and measured positions and counts, never a row height or a label. No critic ran.
